method: Compare nonrecursive root Git trees at the previous and current source commits. Every inventoried source path and the reconciled English locale is covered by an identical ui/ or contracts/ subtree. The unchanged inventory and prior per-path receipt therefore retain their exact source blob and size conclusions without rereading source bodies.
limits: This is an identity refresh of the previously audited candidate set, not a new per-path traversal or a complete dependency qualification.
Root .github/, release/, scripts/ and tests/ changed and are outside this inherited candidate receipt; inspect separately before relying on their current contents.
No SVG, binary, large source, generated manifest, production catalog or lockfile bodies were read.
Existing original-pin provenance and explicit reconciliation/adaptation records remain authoritative.
